intent_summary: Explicit relationships produce ratio, difference, normalized-residual, and joint-condition series with source-level lineage.

criteria.criterion: Ratios retain the computed value, formula, and original source indexes for each sample.
criteria.notes: Assertions check exact ratio values, formula, and both original source indexes.

criteria.criterion: Differences, supplied-scale residuals, and all/any threshold conditions produce the declared derived values.
criteria.notes: Parameterized assertions independently specify difference, normalized residual, all-condition, and any-condition outputs.

criteria.criterion: Missing sources and zero denominators remain unavailable with a reason rather than becoming zero.
criteria.notes: Lineage retains null values with missing_source_value/zero_denominator reasons. Explicit zero_denominator=error intentionally fails instead, as documented.

criteria.criterion: Derived series can be analyzed with the frozen or adaptive single-resolution recipe.
criteria.notes: Both supported recipes dispatch derived datasets through the shared single-resolution engine.
